lines.text: After the earthquake, a fault opened on Amigara Mountain.
The rock was full of holes. Hundreds of them. Shaped like people.
And everyone who came found one shaped exactly like them.
This hole was made for me, a man said.
No light could reach the end of it.
Yoshida found hers next. She couldn't stop staring.
Owaki pulled her away. But on the path down, he saw it.
Months later, they dug into the other side of the mountain.
The holes there weren't shaped like people anymore.
